literal_meaning: বৈতরণী নদী (হিন্দু পুরাণে স্বর্গের পথে অবস্থিত নদী)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার মৃত্যুর পর বৈতরণীর যাত্রা শুরু হলো।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone will cross the Vaitarani one day.
His journey across the Vaitarani began after death.
history: In Hindu mythology, the Vaitarani River is a sacred river that the soul must cross to reach heaven or the afterlife, often depicted as a barrier purified by good deeds.
note: This idiom is deeply tied to Hindu beliefs prevalent in Bengali culture.
